Who is behind this

Hi, I'm Xharig, Star Citizen player and tinkerer. What I missed in the 'verse, I build myself in my spare time: first VerseKit for blueprints, crafting and trading, then VerseSpotter to practise recognising ships.

In the game I fly with the organisation Das Kartell.

New to Star Citizen? Sign up with my referral code STAR-YC7L-S4W2 and you get 50,000 UEC of in-game credit after buying a game package.

Feel free to pass the code on to friends who are just starting, they get the same 50,000 UEC.

Sign up with my code
